messages:
maria: Heads-up — MerchantX is evaluating a full swap from CompetitorCo to Redwood. They want a short POC focused on request/response parity, pricing impact, and security questions. Can we sync on owners and blockers?

tom: Thanks — I can lead the technical POC. Need to confirm: they rely on CompetitorCo streaming + function-calling today, and have bespoke prompt templates with injection guards.

liam: Quick perf question — what sequence lengths and peak qps are they expecting for the POC? affects model selection & batching.

maria: MerchantX said typical prompts ~400 tokens, peaks ~120 rps for inference, burst to 350 for 60s. Budget-conscious — want cost delta estimate.

alex: For parity checklist: 1) API surface (headers, idempotency keys) 2) streaming semantics 3) function call payloads and structured JSON 4) tokenization differences 5) retry/backoff behavior.

tom: Agree. We should replicate a few canonical prompts from them and run side-by-side. I'll ask for 10 representative prompts and expected success criteria.

maria: I requested prompts and a small eval script from MerchantX. ETA EOD tomorrow.

liam: Implementation note: competitor encodes role/assistant in a single array field. Redwood's chat API supports role arrays but our default tokenization may shift token counts — need to log tokens per request.

tom: I'll add a quick shim to translate their request format -> Redwood chat format for the POC. Example shim curl to test streaming behavior:

```bash
curl -s -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $POC_TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-small-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<PROMPT>"}],"stream":true}'
```

tom: Note: streaming frames differ from CompetitorCo; we'll surface equivalent delta and a live replayer.

sophia: Security checklist from our side: SOC2 + ISO statements ready. For MerchantX enterprise, they asked about KMS, token rotation, and IP allowlist. We can support customer-managed KMS in Private deployments, but hosted needs justification.

maria: They flagged a contractual blocker — requirement for data to remain in EU. MerchantX legal asked if Redwood can sign EU residency clause or use dedicated region.

alex: Dedicated capacity (Redwood Dedicated) can be provisioned in eu-west-region and we can include residency in contract. That increases cost tier — flag to pricing.

liam: POC infra ask: will MerchantX want test endpoints behind their VPC or just IP allowlist? VPC/connectors take more lead time.

maria: They prefer IP allowlist for the POC, then evaluate Dedicated + VPC for production.

tom: Action items: 1) I'll build the request translation shim and sample harness (owner: tom) 2) liam will prepare token usage & perf logging for parity report (owner: liam) 3) sophia to prepare short security Q&A + KMS options and checklist (owner: sophia) 4) alex to draft rough pricing delta for 3 scenarios: hosted, reserved, dedicated (owner: alex).

sophia: We'll need MerchantX to sign the NDA before sharing logs containing PII. I'll send the security questionnaire template; ask them to complete redacted examples if needed.

alex: Pricing note — if peak sustained qps >200 we recommend reserved capacity. I'll model their burst pattern and provide a delta (tokens and infra cost) by EOD Friday.

maria: Timeline: POC kickoff Monday, 2-week smoke tests, then parity report. Is that realistic?

tom: Yes for a minimal scope if we get the prompt set tomorrow and test creds. Need a staging token with IP allowlist by Monday morning.

liam: Small gotcha — their eval harness depends on CompetitorCo's per-request metadata header X-Request-Purpose. We should replicate and expose it in logs to keep their monitoring intact.

maria: MerchantX contact confirmed they will provide the prompt set and sample telemetry. I'll require the security NDA signature before they upload logs.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: redwood-poc-shim -> staging at 2024-07-15T09:00Z (automated message).

maria: Perfect — let's reconvene Friday for pricing & security Q&A. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
